description: Java class implementing a fragment for drag-and-drop functionality within an Android app, handling drag start events, image resource management, and view setup.

classes.name: DragSourceFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment class that manages drag-and-drop image sharing, including setting up drag sources, handling drag events, and resource management.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout, initializes image views with draggable images, and restores the state if available.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current local image URI for instance state restoration.

methods.name: setUpDraggableImage
methods.description: Configures an ImageView to start a drag-and-drop operation with specific flags and clip data.

methods.name: getFileUri
methods.description: Copies an image resource to internal storage and returns its content URI via FileProvider.

methods.name: copyImageResourceToFile
methods.description: Copies a drawable resource into a specified file in internal storage.
